items.title: A YouTuber owns GoPro now?
items.summary:
Good morning.
It's easy to forget how much value is in boring main street businesses.
My friend the
Boring Marketer
reminded me of this yesterday.
You don't have to be in PE to purchase your own garage door business though.
Buy up one of the
smaller guys
and follow the same playbook A1 put together.
That dream of owning a surf shop is
very real
!
Estimated reading time: 3 minutes 22 seconds

items.title: Autograph Collectible flipper
items.summary:
Why now
Collectibles values are flying.
The PFC40 Autograph Index is up 825% since 2000.
Source: Paul Fraser Collectibles
A poster signed by one supporting cast member sells for
under $100
. The same poster signed by the whole cast goes for thousands.
The problem: those 5 actors are never in the same room.
The business
You're the network and courier.
You source the half-finished poster in closets
find where each missing name is signing next on
Comic-Con autograph schedule
You flip and split the profit with the owner.
A Batman poster with five cast signatures sold for $2,577.60 in August.

items.title: A YouTuber is the largest shareholder of GoPro now...
items.summary:
Did you see the GoPro thing?
GoPro has been getting smashed in the stock market ( $24 at IPO, 60 cents last week)
Then Markiplier, a gaming YouTuber with ~39 million subscribers,
bought a piece of it
. He wants to make movies on GoPros.
Stock jumped 20%
Creators with distribution are the new private equity.
Attention is the same as a capital injection.

items.title: Brands are buying viral posts as ads (Startup idea)
items.summary:
Good morning.
Google released 3.8 Flash... I tried it with my Hermes agent... it's insanely fast. Made me have a realization about Google's approach.
This model will be a daily driver that powers agents. It won't be heavy or deep thinking for long loops, but it will get work done.
Grok 4.7 is coming next week.
The builders are the winners in this model race. Take advantage.
Estimated reading time: 3 minutes 12 seconds

items.title: Sell brands the viral posts they can boost
items.summary:
Why now
TikTok's
Content Suite
already shows viral videos with spark codes that brands can boost.
It's proven content that they don't have to create.
The problem: Getting the codes is still DMs, one creator at a time.
The product
Be their content pipeline salesmen. You bring posts their own customers already made, cleared and ready to run. You pay the creator, the brand pays you more.
Twenty posts about their product, sorted by views.
What each creator wants for 30 days of ad rights.
The code, ready to paste into Ads Manager.
The date each one expires, so they know when to re-up.
How I’d start
Pick one brand with a lot of organic mentions.
